source='''def transform(grid):
    """Mark cells occupied in both panels above and below the solid divider."""
    divider = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == row[0] for v in row) and row[0] not in (0,))
    height = divider
    top = grid[:height]
    bottom = grid[divider + 1:]
    return [[2 if top[r][c] != 0 and bottom[r][c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(len(top[r]))]
            for r in range(height)]
'''
